画/かく.drop: single kanji: alone it is usually が 'picture'

片/かた.drop: a prefix, not a standalone word; also read へん

かぶれる/かぶれる.meaning: to get a rash, to be influenced by

構える/かまえる.meaning: to set up (a shop), to take a stance

来る/きたる.drop: written alone it reads くる; きたる only before a date

強/きょう.drop: a suffix; the kanji alone suggests つよ-

狂/きょう.drop: a suffix, not a standalone word

故/こ.drop: a prefix; the kanji alone reads ゆえ

こだわる/こだわる.meaning: to be particular about, to fuss over

さらう/さらう.drop: kana alone: snatch, dredge and rehearse are all common

弱/じゃく.drop: a suffix; the kanji alone suggests よわ-

主/しゅ.drop: single kanji: alone it reads ぬし or あるじ

種/しゅ.drop: single kanji: alone it reads たね 'seed'

称/しょう.drop: not a standalone word for learners

証/しょう.drop: single kanji: rare alone, also read あかし

心/しん.drop: single kanji: alone it reads こころ

粋/すい.drop: single kanji: alone it is usually いき 'chic'

先/せん.drop: single kanji: alone it reads さき

角/つの.drop: single kanji: alone also かど and かく, both common

当/とう.drop: a prefix, not a standalone word

とりあえず/とりあえず.meaning: for now, for the time being

はまる/はまる.meaning: to fit, to get hooked on

人気/ひとけ.drop: written alone it reads にんき 'popularity'

ふける/ふける.drop: kana alone: 老ける, 更ける and 耽る are all common

干し/ほし.drop: not a standalone word; meets learners in 干し物 etc.

ボルト/ボルト.drop: volt and bolt are both common

味/み.drop: a suffix; the kanji alone reads あじ

網/もう.drop: single kanji: alone it reads あみ

持てる/もてる.meaning: to be popular, to be able to hold

薬/やく.drop: single kanji: alone it reads くすり

要/よう.drop: single kanji: alone also かなめ
